changes.title: Beta 1: journey reliability
changes.description: Improved stationary drift protection, arrival and departure timing, walking/driving boundaries and interrupted recording recovery. Existing journeys remain explicitly rematchable with their raw recordings preserved.

changes.title: Continuous driving routes
changes.description: Longer verified matching context improves motorway and local-road matching while preserving route continuity and disclosing unsupported GPS gaps.

changes.title: Service-station visits
changes.description: Mapped service grounds and timed dwell evidence distinguish genuine visits from passing traffic. Saved recordings with sufficient evidence can recover previously missed visits.

changes.title: Interactive road Progress
changes.description: Open focused motorway, A-road, B-road and local-road views where supported, with contributing journeys. Map filters and late-saved journey refresh are also included.

changes.title: Beta testing requirements
changes.description: Please test overnight home/school stays, venue running laps, walk–drive–walk transitions and screen-off recovery on Pixel/Samsung. Automated checks do not establish device acceptance. GPS gaps over 90 seconds may prevent automatic venue credit. National Cycle Network collection is reserved for Beta 2.

changes.title: Clearer navigation
changes.description: The icons along the bottom of the app now share the larger size you see in Collections, making it easier to move between screens.

changes.title: More places to explore
changes.description: Road totals and settlement boundaries are now available for 9,072 places across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Your existing road names and progress are preserved.

changes.title: Northern Ireland county progress
changes.description: Northern Ireland's settlements are now linked to their historic counties, so they can contribute to your county progress.

changes.title: Keep up with What's new
changes.description: Open What's new in Utilities to see what each update brings. You can also contact Roadprints to report an issue or suggest a feature.
